result.reason: The operative language reaches the stated fallback: a 90-day software conformance warranty, a 30-day professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, and repair, replacement, or refund remedies. The express-warranty carveouts prevent the broad disclaimer from nullifying those warranties. It does not reach the preferred position because the durations are shorter and there are no compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranties. The fallback is construed as preserving the underlying performance and conformance warranties and the expressly referenced remedies, but not the separate laws and malicious-code requirements omitted from the fallback position.
